remediation_proof_requirements: updated preview or harness report after remediation
checklists.compliance_signoff_notes: Approval absence must remain explicit and must not be normalized away.
Expired approvals must be treated as invalid for execution-readiness purposes.

remediation_proof_requirements: updated trust assignment or policy exception record
checklists.compliance_signoff_notes: Trust-blocked posture is terminal until governance policy changes.

recommended_supporting_evidence: trace event showing provider invalid or missing
escalation_triggers: approval used to mask provider absence
checklists.compliance_signoff_notes: Provider absence precedes and limits approval interpretation.
Tenant violations are terminal until corrected.

escalation_triggers: risky chain without adequate rollback posture
checklists.compliance_signoff_notes: Risky chains require valid rollback evidence before execution-ready posture can be reconsidered.

required_evidence: capability_state output showing registry_missing or unknown posture
remediation_proof_requirements: capability registry artifact or removal of undeclared capability
checklists.compliance_signoff_notes: Unknown capability declarations should not be silently accepted.

recommended_supporting_evidence: harness result or trace evidence of audit insufficiency
escalation_triggers: missing audit evidence for risky or blocked chain
checklists.compliance_signoff_notes: Audit policy invalidity must be treated as a real governance blocker when configured as such.
